0.0: You've been a big help, so I suppose I should hear you out. Let us discuss your concerns.

yes.0: Let me remind you, I still don't fully trust you. I'll only answer questions I feel comfortable answering.

no.0: Why do you hesitate? Is this not what you were after?

1.0:
Now, what are these questions that you seem insistent on asking?
#L0##bAsk about the commanders present when the Black Mage was sealed.#l
#L1#Ask about the other commanders, besides #p2159310#.#l
#L2#Ask about the Black Wings.#l
#L3#End Conversation.#l

1.1: So, you want to know about those dark days. Understand that the battle with the Black Mage happened before I was born, so what I know comes from my mentor. Hopefully, he got all the details straight.

yes.0: I must ask, why do you have such questions? I would have thought you would know more about this than I... Regardless, if you intend to battle these dark forces, be careful.
yes.1: I have answered your questions...but I feel like I owe you more for your assistance. And...you remind me of someone I knew...
yes.2: Here, take this weapon. I found it in Orbis Tower some time ago. With that, we are even, yes? I hate being indebted to people.

0.0: I'm surprised at your questions, but I will answer them as best I can. I just know what my master told me, though. Only #p2159310#, a commander of the Black Mage, knows the full details of that battle and the Black Mage's current condition. But he has remained hidden for so long...
0.1: Unfortunately, I don't know what happened to the other commanders. I assume they remain hidden, building their forces in secret.
0.2: I assume that the Black Wings were founded by one of the commanders to aid the Black Mage in his return. They are way too focused and organized to be a random cult.
